name: webpage-to-markdown-local
title: Webpage to Markdown (Local)
description: Convert a webpage to Markdown locally, without using a cloud conversion service.
author: mikeoertli

commands.name: webpage-to-markdown-local
commands.title: Webpage to Markdown
commands.subtitle: Convert a webpage to Markdown locally
commands.description: Downloads a webpage directly and converts it to Markdown on your computer, without a cloud conversion service. References to image assets use URLs to the online sources.

commands.name: webpage-to-offline-markdown
commands.title: Webpage to Offline Markdown
commands.subtitle: Save Markdown and article images locally
commands.description: Converts a webpage to Markdown where image references point to image assets which have been downloaded into an assets folder. Everything is saved locally.

preferences.name: outputDirectory
preferences.title: Default Output Folder
preferences.description: Where generated Markdown files are saved. Leave blank to use Downloads.

preferences.name: fileNameStyle
preferences.title: Generated File Name Style
preferences.description: Used when no output file name is entered in the command.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Text Editor Command
preferences.description: Command used to open Markdown in an editor, including any arguments. Configure this before using the editor actions.

preferences.name: markdownViewer
preferences.title: Markdown Viewer App
preferences.description: App used to open rendered Markdown. Configure this before using the Markdown viewer actions.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
